metadataHint.parserNotes: If frontmatter is missing, renderer should try to derive title from the first H1 and look for summary/author/date in a short header block.

schemaNotes.purpose: List blog directories and their non-index resources so the client-side renderer can build the directory tree and load the blog entry (index).
conventions: Each blog folder's index entry should point to its main page (index.md or index.html).
'resources' lists files within the blog folder excluding the index file.
'assets' can contain directories or asset paths to be shown/served as needed.
schemaNotes.updateGuidance: When you add a new blog folder, append a new object to 'blogs' with the folder name, index path, and any resource filenames. This manifest is intentionally simple so the renderer can be robust on static hosting.
